answer: Each identity must finish a sequential proof chained to the previous epoch's seed: every step depends on the one before it, so a thousand fakes need a thousand separate sequential runs that cannot be parallelized or shared. A hollow identity with no solved chain is simply ignored. At each close the network emits a pulse that starts the next chain, and all chains drain into a shared lagoon ledger where any duplicated step is visible instantly. A farm of 500 aliases pays 500 full sequential runs, hours of compute each, before one vote counts.
